unit: Center for Peace, Democracy, and Development

labs.lab_name: Center for Peace, Democracy, and Development
labs.location: 4th Floor of Wheatley Hall, 04-128a, Department of Conflict Resolution, Human Security and Global Governance, UMass Boston, 100 Morrissey Blvd., Boston, MA 02125
labs.research_summary: UMass Boston center working on human security in Boston and abroad through peacebuilding and conflict resolution, democratic development, global health and development, and security.
labs.join_notes: No jobs or internship page found on the old or new site pages read; the old site's Employment link goes to the general UMass Boston HR site.
labs.notes: The cached UMB page says the center moved to a Google Sites address; read that for details (lab_website kept as the target start_url). Second co-director is Karen Ross. People page lists faculty fellows, senior fellows and about six PhD center fellows besides the two co-directors; no staff roster, so no count.

labs.research_summary: A group of researchers united by the view of health as social justice, studying what shapes the chances of groups and populations to be healthy.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further.

labs.research_summary: Studies violence, radicalization and their mental health dimensions from several disciplines.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further. Second lab leader: Eben Weitzman.

labs.lab_name: Education and Dialogue for a Peaceful and Just Future Lab
labs.research_summary: Explores education and dialogue in relation to peacebuilding and social change, including a networked peacebuilding measurement project.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further. Second lab leader: Jeff Pugh.

labs.research_summary: Community of researchers, activists and practitioners working on migration and its links to conflict.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further. Other lab leaders: Denise Muro, Cecilia Idika-Kalu.

labs.lab_name: Security, Risk, and Governance Innovation Lab
labs.research_summary: Working group on innovative approaches to security, peace, democracy and governance, with streams on corporate governance, disaster resilience, AI governance and others.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further. Second lab leader: Hannah Brown.

labs.lab_name: Nonviolent Action and Social Change Lab
labs.research_summary: Community of scholars and activists studying and applying nonviolent collective action for social change.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further. Other lab leaders: Karen Ross, Jeff Pugh.

labs.lab_name: Human Security and National Security Lab
labs.research_summary: Examines how state-centered and human-centered security and geopolitics intersect across regions.
labs.notes: Listed on CPDD's Labs page; not read further. Second lab leader: Paul Kowert.
